clover_item_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an inventory item is added or changes in Clover (its name, price or details), with the item as it is now.

output.code: The product code, such as a UPC
output.hidden: True when hidden from the register
output.name: The item's name

clover_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added in Clover, with their name, emails and phone numbers.

output.customerSince: When they became a customer (epoch milliseconds)

clover_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order is created in Clover, at the register, online or through the API, with its total and line items. Orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.lineItems: What was bought ({elements: [{id, name, price}]}), up to 100
output.paymentState: OPEN, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, REFUNDED and so on
output.state: open or locked; empty for a hidden order
output.title: The order's title

clover_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is taken in Clover, with its amount, tip, tax, result and how it was paid. Amounts are in cents.

output.amount: The amount paid, in cents, without the tip
output.result: SUCCESS, FAIL, VOIDED, AUTH and so on
output.tender: How it was paid ({id, label}), such as Cash or Credit Card

clover_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is refunded in Clover, with the amount and the payment.

output.amount: The amount refunded, in cents, with tax and tip
output.reason: Why it was refunded, if given

clover_order_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an order is created or changes in Clover (an item added, a payment taken, a note edited), with the order as it is now.

output.lineItems: What was bought ({elements: [{id, name, price}]}), up to 100
output.paymentState: OPEN, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, REFUNDED and so on
output.state: open or locked; empty for a hidden order
output.title: The order's title
